findings.title: numeric-budget gate is key-scoped, not value-scoped
findings.detail: Verifier.scan and test_no_numeric_budget_anywhere flag a forbidden key (any key containing budget/tolerance plus the frozen list). A budget written as a bare number under a neutral key, or as a numeric element of an untyped list, would not be flagged.
findings.candidate_status: clean: exactly 10 numeric scalars (issue, parent_issue, decision_group_count, max_pins, six size_bytes); none is a budget
findings.impact: latent verifier gap only; does not affect the reviewed artifact
findings.recommendation: future hardening: add a value-level float rule for request-scoped containers

findings.title: several request strings are not type-validated
findings.detail: check_group does not assert the types of title, question, evidence_question_ref, or the elements of not_covered_by_this_group.
findings.candidate_status: all present values are well-formed strings

findings.title: check_groups assumes every group element is a dict
findings.detail: The id comparison filters with isinstance(group, dict) but the later group.get("owner_decision_ids") does not, so a non-dict element raises AttributeError instead of recording a violation.
findings.impact: still fail-closed, but an unclean rejection path not covered by the 18 mutation tests
findings.recommendation: future hardening: guard the declared-id accumulation

findings.title: .. and non-repo absolute prefixes escape the coordination-path check
findings.detail: normalize_path handles case, backslashes, duplicate/leading slashes and ./ and whitespace, but not .. resolution or absolute prefixes, so x/../validation/coordination/y.json or C:/repo/validation/coordination/y.json would not be rejected.
findings.candidate_status: no coordination path appears in the request; pins are additionally closed by exact frozen-path equality
findings.impact: defense-in-depth gap for future path-bearing keys
findings.recommendation: future hardening: normalize with pathlib/PurePosixPath and reject any resolved path containing the coordination segment

findings.title: case-insensitivity claim is stricter than the exercised vector set (informational)
findings.detail: Exercised variants are upper-case, backslash, double-slash, leading-./ and whitespace; no concrete gap found, but the claim is not a proof over all Unicode case folding.

residual_uncertainty: The verifier proves only the structural and byte-identity properties it encodes; it does not prove that the three questions are semantically the right questions for the owner.
The pinned sources' own claims were spot-checked against their key fields, not exhaustively re-derived from the MATLAB model.
Case-insensitive rejection is verified over realistic path variants only (P3-05).
